name: EPIC 201537753
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.7 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201537753 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.67553 (16th-84th percentiles 10.380817-11.034372), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201537753 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.794817 (16th-84th percentiles 0.748992-0.855404), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201537753: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4871.2393 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201537753 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3655.46875 (16th-84th percentiles 3582.460938-3734.375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.05 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,656 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.79 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,871 K at its surface.
